title: Rav Acha son of Rav Nachman
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 114a, but Berakhot 43b reads Mar Zutra son of Rav Nachman; Hyman reports the same reading in Dikdukei Soferim for Shabbat there.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Shabbat 114a fully writes Rabbi Acha son of Rav Nachman, whereas Hyman’s heading fully writes Rav Acha. The full source title is preserved alongside this named witness difference, not harmonized automatically.

The whole Davidson Shabbat 114a paragraph has Rabbi Acha son of Rav Nachman beside Hyman’s fully written Rav Acha heading. The whole Berakhot 43b paragraph has Mar Zutra son of Rav Nachman. These source differences and the existing note remain. Dikdukei Soferim itself was not freshly collated; its reading remains Hyman’s report without a common-father or identity decision.
